title: Secret in a framework or file context (java) — review required
description: A secret is embedded in a java context: jdbc:[^"'s]*[?;&]password=[^"'s]+. Context-shaped secrets (framework keys, connection strings, config values) ship to checkouts and artifacts like any hardcoded value. This lexical rule flags the embedding; the reviewer confirms it is a placeholder or externalizes it.
remediation: Load the value from a secret store plus rotation and rotate the embedded one.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches embedded values regardless of liveness. Generic secret assignments are separate rules.
